name: Channeled Blast
body:
You have learned to shape the divine energies of your channeling, unleashing them, if you desire as a cone instead of a burst.

Prerequisite(s): Channel energy class feature.

Benefit(s): You can, when you channel energy, unleash the energy as a cone instead of a burst. The cone begins from the point of your divine focus and extends to a length equal to twice the radius of your channeling range, with a final width equal to half the length of the cone.
